answer: A decentralized consensus mechanism binds unique staked capital to an identity vault to secure the decision-making grove. Agents must burn native tokens upon deployment, creating a literal sunk cost similar to a comet entering an atmosphere. This ensures that traversing the network is only viable through capital expenditure; thus, a Sybil attacker is forced to pay a steep per-entry tax, rendering the creation of a vast network of fake identities economically infeasible.
